title: Qlik NPrinting Report Report Generation Time p95
app: Qlik NPrinting engine and scheduler logs via UF and the NPrinting API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:nprinting status="Completed"
| eval dur_s=round(duration_s/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by report_name
| where p95_s>120
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile report generation time for each report in Qlik NPrinting and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Qlik NPrinting reports by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Qlik NPrinting timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest reports with their owners.
visualization: Table of report by p95 report generation time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Qlik NPrinting so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
